name: Assurance
overview: Scripture reveals that assurance is a confident trust in God's redeeming power and presence, even amid life's trials and death. Job expresses certainty in his living Redeemer and a future resurrection beyond bodily decay, while the Psalms affirm fearless confidence against enemies and the comfort of God's guiding presence in the darkest moments. This assurance is grounded in God's setting apart the godly and His attentive hearing of their prayers, culminating in the believer's hope to behold God's face in righteousness and be satisfied with His likeness.
